description:
dnGrep allows you to search across files with easy-to-read results.

dnGrep allows you to search across files with easy-to-read results.
Search through text files, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents, PDFs, and archives using text, regular expression, XPath, and phonetic queries. dnGrep includes search-and-replace, whole-file preview, right-click search in File Explorer, and much more.
v5.0.57.0
Changes in this release:
This release does not include any fixes for dnGrep issues.
Release includes updates to

7Zip 26.03 (fixes CVE-2026-58052)
Other third-party library updates
Translations
Updated Translations to several other languages, thank-you for your contributions. Many languages need help to complete them. You are welcome and encouraged to complete or improve any of the existing translations, see Translate dnGrep for more information. Do as much or as little as you like, all help is welcome.
